comment.body: Thanks for confirming this on 0.100.2 and for providing screenshots and a diagnostic report. The reproduction is specific enough for a focused ZoomIt Live Zoom investigation: enable Live Zoom, then open a taskbar flyout and compare the simultaneous zoomed and unzoomed taskbar surfaces. No additional author evidence is currently required before code-level triage.
